text:
maria_sec: heads-up from the nightly vuln scanner — libdbx 2.3.1 shows a deserialization RCE candidate (no public PoC yet). CVSS: 9.8, EPSS: 0.89. tagging for quick triage.
kevin_sre: ack. any affected services identified in SBOM?
jordan_research: I pulled SBOM for infra and runtime images: three services reference libdbx@2.3.1 (ingest-worker, model-cache, embedder). embedder is only in dedicated infra.
maria_sec: no PoC in feeds, but EPSS high -> assume likely exploit attempts in wild. prioritize patch and mitigations.
liz_platform: recommend immediate mitigations: 1) restrict RBAC for embedder's service account to reduce blast radius, 2) enable audit-logging for KMS and deploy services using libdbx, 3) add runtime detection rule to egress proxy for suspicious deserialization patterns.
sre-oncall: ETA to roll patch to dev/staging? canary first then prod.
kevin_sre: patch build for libdbx 2.3.2 (vendor released) — I can push a canary to staging in ~45m. will add circuit breaker and lower concurrency for canary.
jordan_research: quick exploitability check: grep PoC payload patterns in logs, also search for base64-ish blobs to /tmp in embedder containers. no hits in last 72h.
maria_sec: good. assign owners: kevin -> patch rollout, liz -> RBAC + audit gates, jordan -> detection rules + log search. I'll own customer impact comms. @sre-oncall please stand by for canary monitor.
sre-oncall: standing by, will watch latency/error and CPU. will abort and rollback if anomalous. :eyes:
vuln-bot: auto-scan result attached: https://scans.example.com/2711112222/libdbx-2.3.1. vuln-meta: CVSS:9.8, EPSS:0.89, references: [internal-ticket-5891, advisory-2026-DBX].
maria_sec: mitigation plan summary: A) patch dependency to 2.3.2 with canary within 4h, B) RBAC tighten on embedder SA (remove broad read on secrets), C) enable KMS access logs + alert on unusual decrypts, D) detection rule deployed to egress proxy, E) validate backports for 2.2 LTS branch.
kevin_sre: will target canary in staging -> canary in prod region-1 -> full rollout if green. will include step to avoid live key rewraps (no KMS key rotation during rollout).
liz_platform: RBAC change PR drafted: remove workloads/* role, add least-privilege secrets accessor. tagging infra-owners for approval.
jordan_research: detection rule snippet (quick):
```
match: base64_deser_pattern
action: alert, quarantine
threshold: 3 per 10m per host
```
will iterate after initial false-positive sweep.
maria_sec: decision: treat as P1 for triage (not incident yet, but urgent). opening security ticket and scheduling 1hr huddle in #incidents if canary trips.
sre-oncall: noted — I'll create a pager if errors spike >5% or CPU >80% for 3m.
maria_sec: final ask: capture full SBOM and list of customers using embedder in Dedicated — product will reach out if we need to notify. closing here once patch is in canary and RBAC PR merged. :white_check_mark:
